name: media_convert
description: Convert a video or audio file to another format or codec. The output extension (or format) decides the container, with sensible codecs chosen automatically: mp4/mov/mkv → H.264 + AAC, webm → VP9 + Opus, mp3, m4a, wav, flac, ogg/opus. Override with video_codec (h264, h265, vp9, av1, copy) and audio_codec (aac, mp3, opus, flac, copy, none), and optionally cap the height or change the frame rate.

input.description: Path of the video or audio file, relative to the workspace.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. Its extension picks the format. Default: next to the input.

format.description: Target format when output is not given, such as mp4, webm, mkv, mov, mp3, m4a, wav, flac or opus.

video_codec.description: auto (default), h264, h265, vp9, av1 or copy.

audio_codec.description: auto (default), aac, mp3, opus, flac, copy or none (drop audio).

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

audio_bitrate.description: Audio bitrate such as 128k, 192k or 320k. Default 192k.

max_height.description: Scale down to at most this many pixels high (e.g. 720). Never scales up.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
